All 4 checklist items are missing the userSees field. CLAUDE.md checklist spec requires userSees with precise user-facing output text (e.g., the exact commit message format the user would see, the exact skip message when non-metadata dirt coexists, the exact session-brief line showing auto-committed paths). Without userSees, product verification at DEV/TEST time has no concrete acceptance text to compare against. Recommend adding userSees to at least CHK-001, CHK-002, and CHK-003 before advancing.
